title: Heat Check, Week 4
dek: Rashee Rice went from 2 targets to 6 to 9. The Kansas City passing game is his again.
author: Chef Hazy
intro_md:
Updated Fri 5:00 PM ET: Bucky Irving practiced in full Friday with no designation and stays RB19, an RB2; Kenyon Sadiq is questionable (back) with Mason Taylor ruled out.

Updated Thu 10:45 PM ET: added Jeremiyah Love, Drake London, Brock Bowers, Harold Fannin Jr., Isaiah Likely, Matthew Golden, Chuba Hubbard and Luther Burden III as risers, and Emeka Egbuka, Xavier Worthy, David Montgomery, Chris Godwin Jr., Kyle Pitts Sr., Travis Kelce, Bucky Irving and James Cook III as fallers. Josh Downs is WR17 for me this week @WAS, a WR2, and Cam Skattebo is RB15, an RB2.

Updated Wed 3:45 PM ET: Omarion Hampton's snap share is 58, 63 and 42 percent (Week 1 was never 80), Terrance Ferguson moves from monitor to sit with McVay saying he will probably miss Sunday, and TreVeyon Henderson's watch is now his third-down and short-yardage snaps.

Updated Wed 3:40 PM ET: Wan'Dale Robinson ran a route on 81 percent of the dropbacks; two snap counts disagree on his Week 3 snaps, so the snap jump is gone. The claim stands.

Updated Tue 6:55 PM ET: corrected Rashee Rice's Week 3 target share to 41% (18.7% is his three-game share); the trade-for call stands.

Heat Check is about direction, not box scores. A riser earned more of the ball three weeks running or got a new role you can see in the snap counts. A faller is losing snaps, routes or targets, or just lost the thing his role depended on. One number backs each call. PPR scoring.
outro_md: The trade prices for these trends are in the Butcher Shop, and the Menu lands Wednesday.

risers.price: a WR3 and a bench RB
risers.why: Rice led the Chiefs in targets, catches and yards @MIA in Week 3 with 7 catches for 88 yards on 9 targets. He drew 9 of the Chiefs' 22 targets in Week 3, a 41% share, after 9.5% through two games; his three-game share is 18.7%.
risers.verdict: Trade for him; offer a WR3 and a bench RB before the price catches up.

risers.stat: Snap share 43% in Weeks 1 and 2, 64% in Week 3
risers.why: Love out-snapped Tyler Allgeier for the first time @SF in Week 3, 56 snaps to 31, and took 21 of the backs' 23 carries for 90 plus 5 of 5 targets. Allgeier kept 3 of the 5 goal-line snaps.

risers.stat: 10 of 25 attempts; routes on 24 of 25 dropbacks
risers.why: Michael Penix Jr. replaced Cooper Rush in Week 3 and threw London 10 of his 25 passes @GB. London caught 9 for 194, and Penix averaged 10.4 targets a game to him in their nine 2025 games together.
risers.verdict: WR7 for me this week @NO on Monday night.

risers.stat: 13 of 30 targets in his first game back
risers.why: Bowers drew 43 percent of the targets in his season debut and caught 10 for 116 and a touchdown. He lined up in the slot or out wide on 45 of 55 snaps, so he is playing receiver.
risers.verdict: The top tight end for me this week vs KC.

risers.why: Alec Pierce left Week 2 with a heel injury and is now on IR, and Downs has been the Colts' top target since. He caught 7 of 9 for 72 yards in Week 2 and 5 of 11 for 77 vs HOU in Week 3.
risers.verdict: WR17 for me this week @WAS in London, a WR2. He is WR35 rest of season, so the rise lasts while Pierce is out.

risers.why: Fannin drew a 30 percent target share vs CAR in Week 3 and caught 7 for 51 and 2 touchdowns on 87 percent of the snaps. He also had 45 percent of the air yards while Jerry Jeudy ran 23 routes without a target.
risers.verdict: He is TE8 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a TE in the 12 to 16 range and a bench piece.
risers.price: a TE in the 12 to 16 range and a bench piece

risers.why: Skattebo took every first-quarter snap vs TEN in Week 3 and finished with 20 carries, 3 catches and 100 scrimmage yards. That is his most touches of the season with Jameis Winston at QB.
risers.verdict: RB15 for me this week vs ARI, an RB2.

risers.why: Likely ran 22 routes on 27 dropbacks vs TEN in Week 3 and drew 5 targets, 24 percent of the throws, in the nor'easter. He has 7 catches for 46 since Week 1, so the box score has not caught up to the playing time.
risers.verdict: TE9 for me this week vs ARI.

risers.stat: Routes on 44 of 55 dropbacks; 25% of targets
risers.why: Golden ran a route on 44 of 55 dropbacks vs ATL in Week 3, and he has a quarter of the Packers' targets and 40 percent of their air yards. Jayden Reed is out for the season after neck surgery, and his slot work is split three ways.
risers.verdict: WR19 for me this week @TB, a WR2.

risers.why: Hubbard played 65 of 77 snaps @CLE in Week 3 with 19 carries for 82 and 4 catches on 4 targets, with Jonathon Brooks on IR. AJ Dillon got 4 carries on 12 snaps.
risers.verdict: RB12 for me this week vs DET, borderline RB1/RB2.

risers.stat: 32% of targets in Week 3; 25% on the season
risers.why: Burden drew 11 targets vs PHI in Week 3 and caught 7 for 61 and a touchdown on 74 percent of the routes. He leads the Bears with a 25 percent target share and 28 percent targets per route.
risers.verdict: WR26 for me this week vs NYJ, a high-end WR3 and a flex play.

risers.stat: Targets 7 in Weeks 1 and 2 combined, then 11 in Week 3 on 81 percent of the routes
risers.why: Robinson drew a game-high 11 targets @NYG in Week 3 and caught 7 for 57 yards and a touchdown. He ran a route on 81 percent of the dropbacks, and Cam Ward looked for him first in the rain.
risers.verdict: WR41 for me this week @BAL, a low-end flex play to a dart throw in PPR. Claim him, 2 to 5 percent of FAAB.

risers.why: Sadiq ran a route on 40 percent of dropbacks through Week 2, then played a season-high 38 snaps @DET with Mason Taylor out and caught 7 of 8 for 105 yards and a touchdown. Taylor and Adonai Mitchell are ruled out for Week 4; Sadiq is questionable with a back injury after two limited practices.
risers.verdict: TE12 for me this week @CHI, a borderline start. Claim him, 12 to 20 percent of FAAB.

fallers.price: a top-15 RB who catches passes, or a WR2
fallers.why: Hampton got 15 of the backfield's 24 carries @BUF but ran 6 routes and drew 1 target. His routes have gone 10, 10 and 6 by week, he has 3 targets all season, and two other backs ran more than twice as many routes in Week 3.
fallers.verdict: RB12 rest of season for me on the carries alone. Trade him away; ask for a top-15 RB who catches passes or a WR2.

fallers.why: Egbuka slipped to 74 percent of the snaps in Week 3 when Tampa Bay went to two tight ends, though he drew a season-high 9 targets. Baker Mayfield is out at least three weeks with the thumb, and undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels starts vs GB.
fallers.verdict: WR40 for me this week vs GB, a low-end flex play to a dart throw. Trade him away; ask for a WR2 in a steadier offense.
fallers.price: a WR2 in a steadier offense

fallers.stat: Targets 13 in Weeks 1 and 2, 2 in Week 3
fallers.why: Worthy led the Kansas City receivers with 43 snaps @MIA in Week 3 but drew 2 targets on 19 routes while Rashee Rice drew 9. He has 10 catches for 63 yards on 15 targets this season.
fallers.verdict: WR50 for me this week @LV, a dart throw. Drop him for any add on this week's list.

fallers.why: Montgomery's touches went 23, 8 and 13, and he is running at 2.8 a carry. Woody Marks has 50 routes to his 56 and scored Houston's goal-line touchdown at IND.
fallers.verdict: RB22 for me this week vs DAL, an RB2 on volume alone. Trade him away; ask for a RB2 who leads his backfield.
fallers.price: a RB2 who leads his backfield

fallers.why: Godwin fell from 86 to 62 percent of the snaps in Week 3 when Tampa Bay went to two tight ends, and caught 3 for 25. He missed Wednesday's practice with an ankle injury before returning Thursday, and a rookie quarterback starts vs GB.
fallers.verdict: WR57 for me this week vs GB, a dart throw; sit him.

fallers.stat: 9 targets in 3 games; 4 on 62 routes in Weeks 1 and 2
fallers.why: Harrison caught 3 of 5 for 40 yards in the Week 3 loss to SF, under 10 percent of the targets again. Michael Wilson drew 14 targets on 67 routes over the first two weeks while Harrison drew 4.
fallers.verdict: WR60 for me this week @NYG, a dart throw; sit him until the target share clears 15 percent.

fallers.stat: 1 target in Week 3; 13 on the year to Parker Washington's 23
fallers.why: Thomas caught his only target for 8 yards vs NE in Week 3 and has no touchdowns. Parker Washington has out-targeted him 23 to 13.
fallers.verdict: Drop him for any add on this week's list.

fallers.stat: 6 targets in 3 games; 2 on 19 routes in Week 3
fallers.why: Pitts played fewer snaps than Charlie Woerner @GB in Week 3 and drew 2 targets on 19 routes. He has 2 catches for 20 yards in three games while Drake London took 10 of Michael Penix Jr.'s 25 throws.
fallers.verdict: TE22 for me this week @NO, outside my top 12; sit him.

fallers.why: Ferguson ran a route on 72 percent of dropbacks in Week 2 and drew a 30 percent target share, then hurt his ankle @DEN and his route share fell to 15.6 percent. Sean McVay said Monday he will probably miss Sunday at PHI. Tyler Higbee caught 8 of 11 in his place on 47 routes.
fallers.verdict: TE37 for me this week @PHI, outside my top 12; sit him and stream Higbee.

fallers.stat: Targets 16 in Weeks 1 and 2, 2 in Week 3
fallers.why: Kelce ran 19 routes on 24 dropbacks @MIA in Week 3 and drew 2 targets while Rashee Rice drew 9. He turned them into 59 yards and a touchdown, which hides the drop.
fallers.verdict: TE5 for me this week @LV. Monitor his target count @LV Sunday; a second game under 4 makes him a trade-away.

fallers.why: Irving's snap share went 61, 78 and 52 percent, and he sat the last two possessions vs MIN on what the coordinator calls a pitch count. He practiced in full Friday after two limited days with a glute injury and has no designation, and Kenny Gainwell played 46 percent of the snaps in Week 3.
fallers.verdict: RB19 for me this week vs GB, an RB2. Monitor his fourth-quarter snaps Sunday.
fallers.watch: his fourth-quarter snaps vs GB Sunday
third-down and short-yardage snaps next to Stevenson @BUF Sunday
fallers.why: Henderson out-snapped Rhamondre Stevenson 33 to 20 in Week 2, then Stevenson took it back 33 to 23 at JAX in Week 3 and took most of the passing-situation and short-yardage snaps, 3 catches to 1. Henderson ran 8 times for 23 yards.
fallers.verdict: RB29 for me this week @BUF, a high-end RB3. Monitor his third-down and short-yardage snaps next to Stevenson on Sunday.

fallers.why: Ty Johnson came back in Week 3 and took most of the passing-down snaps, catching 4 of 4 for 50, while Cook drew 1 target and no catch. Cook kept 81 percent of the early downs and ran 24 times for 154, so the carries are safe and the catches are the worry.
fallers.verdict: RB11 for me this week vs NE, borderline RB1/RB2. Monitor his targets and third-down snaps vs NE Sunday.
fallers.watch: his targets and third-down snaps vs NE Sunday
